chalisa.do1: Having cleansed the mirror of my mind with the dust of my revered Guru's lotus feet, I describe the spotless glory of Śrī Rāma, best of the Raghus, which bestows the four fruits of life (dharma, wealth, desire and liberation).
chalisa.do2: Knowing myself to be devoid of intelligence, I remember you, O son of the Wind. Grant me strength, intelligence and knowledge, and take away my afflictions and impurities.
chalisa.cau1: Glory to you, Hanumān, ocean of wisdom and virtue! Glory to you, lord of the monkeys, renowned in all three worlds! ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: You are Śrī Rāma's messenger, the abode of matchless strength, known by the names Añjanī's son and son of the Wind. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: O great hero, mighty in valour, with limbs hard as a thunderbolt, you dispel evil thoughts and are the companion of those whose minds are good. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: Golden in hue, you shine in fine attire, with earrings in your ears and curly hair. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: In your hands shine the thunderbolt and the banner, and a sacred thread of muñja grass adorns your shoulder. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: Born of Śaṅkara, son of Kesarī, your splendour and might are great, and the whole world worships you. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: Learned, virtuous and exceedingly wise, you are ever eager to do Śrī Rāma's work. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: You delight in hearing the Lord's story; Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa and Sītā dwell in your heart. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: Taking a tiny form, you showed yourself to Sītā; taking a formidable form, you burnt Laṅkā. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Taking a terrible form, you slew the demons and accomplished Śrī Rāmacandra's tasks. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: You brought the life-giving herb and revived Lakṣmaṇa, and Śrī Raghuvīra joyfully clasped you to his heart. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: The lord of the Raghus praised you greatly: You are as dear to me as my brother Bharata. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: The thousand-mouthed Śeṣa sings your glory, said the consort of Lakṣmī, and embraced you. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Sanaka and the other sages, Brahmā and the other gods, the great sages, Nārada, Sarasvatī and Śeṣa, the lord of serpents (sing your glory). ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: When Yama, Kubera and the guardians of the quarters cannot tell it fully, how could poets and scholars? ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: You did Sugrīva a favour: you brought him to Rāma and gave him the kingdom. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Vibhīṣaṇa heeded your counsel and became the king of Laṅkā; the whole world knows it. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: The sun, thousands of yojanas away, you swallowed, taking it for a sweet fruit. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Holding the Lord's ring in your mouth, you leapt across the ocean; no wonder in that. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: However many hard tasks there are in the world, all become easy by your grace. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: You are the guardian of Rāma's door; no one enters there without your leave. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Whoever takes refuge in you finds every joy; with you as protector, there is nothing to fear. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: You alone can contain your own splendour; the three worlds tremble at your roar. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: Ghosts and demons do not come near when the name of the great hero is uttered. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: Disease is destroyed and all pain removed by ceaselessly repeating the name of the brave Hanumān. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Hanumān frees from distress whoever fixes their meditation on him in thought, word and deed. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Rāma, the ascetic king, is supreme over all, and you accomplished all his tasks. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Whoever comes with any other wish obtains its fruit without limit in this life. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Your glory spreads through all four ages, famed as a light across the world. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: You are the protector of saints and holy men, the destroyer of demons, the darling of Rāma. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Mother Jānakī granted you the boon of being the giver of the eight siddhis and the nine treasures. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: You hold the elixir of Rāma('s name); may you ever remain the servant of the lord of the Raghus. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Through devotion to you one attains Rāma and leaves behind the sorrows of birth after birth. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: At the end one goes to the city of Rāma, and wherever one is born, is called a devotee of Hari. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Even without holding any other deity in mind, one who serves Hanumān gains every joy. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Troubles are cut away and all pain removed for whoever remembers the mighty hero Hanumān. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Glory, glory, glory to you, Lord Hanumān! Be gracious to me as my Guru is. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Whoever recites this a hundred times is released from bondage and finds great joy. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Whoever reads this Hanumān Chālīsā attains success; Śiva, lord of Gaurī, is witness to it. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Tulasīdāsa is ever Hari's servant; O Lord, make your dwelling in my heart. ॥40॥
chalisa.do3: O son of the Wind, remover of troubles, embodiment of auspiciousness, king of the gods: dwell in my heart together with Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa and Sītā.
